title: Nifty 50 in danger zone? Here’s where the index could head next - Check key levels
text: Nifty 50 in danger zone? Here’s where the index could head next - Check key levels. Domestic equities rebounded slightly on September 11, following a drop in global crude prices and buying interest at lower levels. The Nifty 50 closed 0.34% lower at 23,398, indicating ongoing weakness and potential support around 23,200–23,250, while resistance is seen at 24,100.
